title: Two-seam machine composition
statement: Let $M_0,M_1,M_2$ be deterministic Turing machines with a common input alphabet and the same number of work tapes, with state sets $S_0,S_1,S_2$. Choose exit states $e_1,e_2\in S_0$ and entry states $b_1\in S_1,b_2\in S_2$. The resulting machine, with states $(S_0\sqcup S_1)\sqcup S_2$, first composes $M_0$ with $M_1$ by sending state $e_1$ to $b_1$, then composes that machine with $M_2$ by sending the state corresponding to $e_2$ in the $S_0$ summand to $b_2$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
Machines $M_0,M_1,M_2$ over a common symbol alphabet
